changes: Made story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK atomic (Option A: bootstrap the worktree first, persist phase=INIT_CHECK only after dev_start succeeds; on gate/bootstrap failure throw and leave the story at its prior phase — no partial advance). Exposed dev_start as a recovery CLI command (MAIN_TOOLS + command-policy storyScopedMutating allowedPhases INIT/INIT_CHECK/PLAN/DEV + DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS INIT_CHECK/PLAN + process-fact-levels companion). Relaxed dev_start to accept phase INIT with the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate extended to fire for INIT. Added regression smoke init-check-atomicity-smoke.ts (4 assertions).
usage: Normal flow unchanged: lattice story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK creates the worktree then advances. If bootstrap fails the command exits non-zero and the story stays at INIT. To recover a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree on disk, run lattice dev_start {"storyId":"B-xxx"} which re-bootstraps and prints the worktree Path.
expectedOutcome: On bootstrap failure: non-zero exit, message reporting the abort, and story_get shows the prior phase (INIT) not INIT_CHECK. On recovery: lattice dev_start prints Story B-xxx development environment is ready / Path: .../.worktrees/B-xxx and recreates the worktree.
actualTranscript: init-check-atomicity-smoke asserts: failed bootstrap -> story_advance INIT_CHECK exits non-zero, output matches /INIT_CHECK aborted|scope|freeze/, story_get phase===INIT, no worktree; recovery -> dev_start exit 0 with Path: line and worktree dir present (idempotent on re-run); refusals -> dev_start non-zero for DONE/REVIEW and unfrozen INIT. Real story_advance INIT_CHECK happy path -> exit 0, phase===INIT_CHECK, worktree created + recorded on index. lattice validate ALL PASS; coverage 9/9.
outcomeDiff: No diff: expected and actual match. All 4 smoke assertions pass, validate green, verification coverage 9/9, delivery-check signed 5/5 promises verified.
limitations: Recovery for the rare phaseDetectionFailed branch (story_get itself throwing) is now guarded by the same pre-check; review escalation was satisfied via degraded-single-host fallback (single driver agent, no independent second review host available in this environment).
pitfalls: dev_start is now a public command but remains gated: command-policy allowedPhases + DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS limit it to INIT/INIT_CHECK/PLAN/DEV and the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate still applies to INIT/INIT_CHECK bootstrap — do not assume it can recreate worktrees for terminal or unfrozen stories.
